title: Training Attendance Approval Form
subtitle: Use this approval to test evidence and authority, resolve conflicts, issue a bounded decision, and verify every resulting update for a training attendance workflow.
description: An original operational training attendance approval form that controls a controlled learning-session attendance and participation record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the training coordinator, facilitator, manager, or learner needs a traceable approval so the authorized learning, compliance, safety, or qualification reviewer can credit attendance, assign partial credit, require make-up, correct the roster, or withhold completion under the approved curriculum, roster rules, prerequisite matrix, delivery standard, and qualification policy without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Training Attendance approval submission and authority route
sections.guidance: Identify the proposed action, submitter, decision authority, effective point, and required evidence.

blocks.label: Training Attendance identity
Approval ownership and routing
Approval control
Proposed action, purpose, exact scope, affected people or work, exclusions, and requested conditions

sections.title: Training Attendance evidence completeness and readiness
sections.guidance: Reject unsupported assumptions before the decision reaches an approver.

blocks.label: Training Attendance approval readiness
items: Course, revision, instructor, and delivery method are approved
Roster population and learner assignments are accurate
Prerequisites and support needs are addressed
Attendance-capture method can preserve start, end, and missed segments
Required participation and assessment evidence are available
Make-up route exists for partial or interrupted attendance
Attendance is not represented as competency without separate evidence
Learning-system update and retention have accountable owners

blocks.label: Evidence package submitted
items: Approved curriculum and session assignment
Instructor authorization and delivery record
Controlled roster with identity verification
Arrival, departure, break, and missed-segment evidence
Participation, exercise, knowledge-check, or module evidence
Accessibility, interruption, make-up, or incident reference
Learner and instructor acknowledgment
Learning-system completion and qualification-status update

blocks.label: Required item, evidence, owner, status, and deficiency

sections.title: Training Attendance policy, authority, and impact review
sections.guidance: Apply the current decision standard and record each reviewer within their actual authority.

blocks.label: Training Attendance policy and impact checks
items: Session used the approved course and curriculum revision
Instructor or facilitator was authorized for the delivery
Learner identity and assigned requirement were verified
Arrival, departure, breaks, and missed segments support the claimed attendance
Required participation, exercises, or knowledge checks were completed
Accessibility, language, and technical barriers were addressed
Practical demonstration or qualification is not inferred from attendance alone
Make-up assignment maps to the exact missed content
Roster and learning-system records reconcile
Completion status and next requirement have accountable owners

blocks.label: Review area, reviewer, authority, evidence, finding, and condition
People, schedule, service, cost, payroll, privacy, security, safety, consistency, and system impacts

sections.title: Training Attendance conflicts, exceptions, and approval conditions
sections.guidance: Resolve material conflicts and convert every condition into owned, verifiable work.

blocks.label: Approval stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the authorized learning, compliance, safety, or qualification reviewer under the approved curriculum, roster rules, prerequisite matrix, delivery standard, and qualification policy.

blocks.label: Training Attendance exception and escalation triggers
items: Wrong learner, course, revision, or session received attendance credit
Roster signature or electronic evidence appears duplicated or misattributed
Required content, instructor, demonstration, or assessment was omitted
Technology, location, evacuation, or safety event interrupted material content
Learner missed a segment but was recorded as fully complete
Accessibility or language support failed to provide meaningful access
Attendance record was altered after sign-off without an audit trail
Learning system, roster, qualification record, and manager status conflict

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale
Approval condition, prerequisite, owner, due point, evidence, and expiry

sections.title: Training Attendance approval decision and effective boundary
sections.guidance: Record one unambiguous decision with rationale, authority, conditions, and review date.

blocks.label: Approval boundary
blocks.guidance: Approval is valid only within the stated scope and authority. The authorized learning, compliance, safety, or qualification reviewer must apply the approved curriculum, roster rules, prerequisite matrix, delivery standard, and qualification policy; a signature does not override a required privacy, safety, security, legal, payroll, tax, or accommodation review.

blocks.label: Approval decision
Evidence relied upon, contrary evidence, alternatives, conditions, limits, and reason for decision
Submission, qualified review, and decision authorization

fields.label: Authorized Learning, Compliance, Safety, Or Qualification Reviewer / date

sections.title: Training Attendance implementation, notification, and approval closeout
sections.guidance: Verify that the approved outcome reached every affected system and recipient.

blocks.label: Approved implementation, system update, notification, and verification
Approval outcome and handoff
Open training attendance action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
Approval accountable review

fields.label: Authorized Learning, Compliance, Safety, Or Qualification Reviewer / date
